rows.original: New NVIDIA CEO named by December 31, 2026?

markets.question: New NVIDIA CEO named by December 31, 2026?
markets.label: Yes（是）
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if NVIDIA Corporation officially announces a successor to Jensen Huang as CEO of NVIDIA by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

An announcement of a successor will be sufficient for a "Yes" resolution regardless of if/when the announced replacement actually becomes the next CEO of NVIDIA.

Interim CEOs will not qualify.

The resolution source will be public statements from NVIDIA Corporation, however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

markets.question: Will the Fed decrease interest rates by 50+ bps after the December 2026 meeting?
markets.label: 降息50基点及以上
markets.rules:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's December 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for December 8-9, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their December meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

rows.title: Jensen Huang out as NVIDIA CEO again by...?
rows.original: Jensen Huang out as NVIDIA CEO again by...?

markets.question: Jensen Huang announced resignation or removal again by December 31, 2026?
markets.label: December 31, 2026
markets.rules:
On November 23, 2026, NVIDIA announced that its Board of Directors had reinstated Jensen Huang as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if Jensen Huang’s departure through resignation or removal as CEO of NVIDIA is officially announced between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Announcements made before this market’s creation, including NVIDIA’s November 12, 2026 announcement of Jensen Huang’s resignation, will not qualify.

The departure will be considered to be announced when Jensen Huang, NVIDIA, or their authorized representatives publicly and definitively announce that Huang has resigned or been removed, or will resign or be removed, as CEO of NVIDIA. Such an announcement will qualify regardless of when the specified person formally leaves the position; resignation includes retiring or stepping down as CEO, including to take another role at NVIDIA, and removal includes dismissal or termination by NVIDIA’s Board of Directors.

Only announcements which are framed as announcing a departure through resignation or removal intended to be effective within 18 months of the date of the announcement will qualify (e.g., neither “I will leave office in 2 years,” nor “I will not be in office forever,” would qualify).

Announcements of temporary leaves of absence, dated suspensions, indefinite suspensions, administrative leaves, or other temporary changes to the specified person’s duties in the specified position do not qualify.

The following do not qualify as public and definitive announcements: statements that the specified person is considering or open to departing; conditional statements that the specified person will depart only if certain conditions are met; the announcement of an offer of resignation that requires acceptance and remains pending or has been refused; media reports that the specified person plans to depart; statements made in sarcasm or jest; and statements by persons other than the specified person, the relevant authority governing the specified position, or their respective authorized representatives.

If the specified person holds the specified position on a predefined term with a scheduled end date, only announcements that they will depart the position prior to the scheduled end of their term qualify.

If the specified person formally ceases to hold the specified position before the end of their scheduled term through such a departure without a qualifying announcement, the market will resolve to “Yes” if a qualifying resignation or removal occurs by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. If the specified person ceases to hold the specified position by any other means, this market will resolve to “No”.

The primary resolution sources for this market will be official information from Jensen Huang and NVIDIA; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

rows.title: Fourth Jensen Huang affair reported by...?
rows.original: Fourth Jensen Huang affair reported by...?

markets.question: Fourth Jensen Huang affair reported by December 31?
markets.label: December 31
markets.rules:
On November 8, 2026, Jensen Huang acknowledged in a message to NVIDIA employees that he had been unfaithful to his wife; news reports have identified the woman involved as Alice Huang. On November 11, 2026, The New York Times reported that Huang had also had an affair with Kimberly Powell, NVIDIA’s vice president of healthcare; Huang, Powell and NVIDIA have not confirmed that report. On November 12, 2026, Reuters reported that Huang had an intimate relationship with a second NVIDIA employee, whom it did not name.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if, between market creation and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, a qualifying outlet publishes a qualifying report of an affair between Jensen Huang and any person other than Alice Huang, Kimberly Powell or the NVIDIA employee reported by Reuters. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

An affair refers to a romantic or sexual relationship outside Jensen Huang’s marriage. The affair itself may have taken place at any time during his marriage; only the timing of the report matters.

The qualifying outlets are The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, Financial Times, Reuters, the Associated Press, CNN, Bloomberg, ABC News, CBS News, NBC News and Fox News. Only news articles published on an outlet’s own platform qualify; editorials, opinion pieces, columns, broadcast or video segments, podcasts, social media posts and sponsored content will not qualify.

A report will qualify if it meets any of the following:
1. presents the affair as fact;
2. reports the affair based on the outlet’s own sourcing, such as people familiar with the matter, documents or recordings (as in The New York Times’ November 11, 2026 report on Kimberly Powell);
3. reports an alleged affair between Jensen Huang and a specific person other than Alice Huang, Kimberly Powell or the employee reported by Reuters, regardless of whether the outlet presents the allegation as credible; or
4. reports that Jensen Huang, directly or through his official or legal representatives, has acknowledged such an affair.

Reports under 1 or 2 qualify whether or not the person involved is named, provided they clearly distinguish that person from Alice Huang, Kimberly Powell and the unnamed NVIDIA employee reported by Reuters. A report does so if it, or other reporting from a qualifying outlet, makes clear that the person is not that employee (e.g., by describing them as a third NVIDIA employee with whom Huang had a relationship, or as someone who has never worked at NVIDIA), or if it confirms that Huang had affairs with at least four people.

The following will not qualify:
(i) reports that name or otherwise identify the NVIDIA employee reported by Reuters;
(ii) reports about any person, named or unnamed, that do not make clear, on their own or together with other reporting from a qualifying outlet, that the person is not the NVIDIA employee reported by Reuters;
(iii) general references to Huang’s infidelity (e.g., “Huang has been unfaithful for a while”); and
(iv) allegations about an unnamed person that the outlet only relays from others, such as social media posts or other outlets’ reporting.

A report under 4 qualifies only if it reports an acknowledgment, including one in private testimony that has been made public, that names a person other than Alice Huang and Kimberly Powell who is distinguished from the employee reported by Reuters as described above, or makes clear that Huang was unfaithful with someone other than them (for example, by acknowledging affairs with four or more people). Reports of acknowledgments that are not explicit and unambiguous, or that are clearly sarcastic, made in jest or immediately clarified as not being genuine, will not qualify.

A qualifying report must be first published between market creation and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Reports that only reference or link to articles published before market creation will not qualify unless they themselves meet the requirements above. An article first published before market creation will qualify only if a later update first makes it meet the requirements above, in which case the time of the update governs.

The resolution source for this market will be reporting from the qualifying outlets; for acknowledgments, official information from Jensen Huang or his official or legal representatives may also be used.

rows.title: B200 average rental price in June 2027?
rows.original: B200 average rental price in June 2027?

markets.question: Will the average Ornn B200 rental price in June 2027 be above $14.00?
markets.label: Above $14.00
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the average Ornn B200 index value in June 2027 is above the specified price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The average Ornn B200 index value in June 2027 is the arithmetic mean of the finalized daily settled values of the Ornn OCPI-B200 index dated within June 2027, as published by Ornn, rounded to the nearest cent. A daily settled value is considered finalized once the following day's settled value is published. Revisions made after a value has been finalized will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market is Ornn (data.ornn.com), specifically the Ornn Compute Price Index for the B200 (OCPI-B200), currently displayed at https://data.ornn.com/markets/b200.

In the case that the Resolution Source publishes data, sufficient to settle a Market, that is clearly erroneous and the result of technical or operational error, or of unauthorized interference with the Resolution Source or its data, the Market may remain open for a period of up to seven (7) calendar days (ET) from the time of the expected original release, in anticipation of a correction by the Resolution Source. If the Resolution Source publishes a corrected value within that period, that value will be eligible for resolution.

If any value for June 2027 is not finalized by 11:59 PM ET on the 7th calendar day after June 2027 ends, this market will resolve using the finalized values available at that time.

If Ornn discontinues the OCPI-B200 index, the page becomes unavailable, or Ornn materially changes the index methodology or unit of measure, and as a result no finalized OCPI-B200 values dated within June 2027 are available by 11:59 PM ET on July 7, 2027, another credible source of B200 rental price data will be considered. If no such source is available, this market will resolve 50-50.

rows.title: Jensen Huang admits to another affair with a woman by December 31?
rows.original: Jensen Huang admits to another affair with a woman by December 31?

markets.question: Jensen Huang admits to another affair with a woman by December 31?
markets.label: Yes（是）
markets.rules:
On November 8, 2026, Jensen Huang sent a message to NVIDIA employees in which he stated “I was unfaithful to my wife.” The message did not name the woman involved. News reports have identified that woman as Alice Huang.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if, between market creation and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, Jensen Huang publicly acknowledges a romantic or sexual relationship outside his marriage with a woman other than Alice Huang. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A qualifying acknowledgment must name a woman other than Alice Huang, or make clear that Huang was unfaithful with more than one person (for example, by acknowledging multiple affairs or multiple partners). An acknowledgment that does not name the woman involved and could refer to Alice Huang will not qualify.

The November 8, 2026 message, any statement that repeats, confirms or adds detail about the relationship with Alice Huang, and any general statement about being unfaithful that does not meet the requirements above will not qualify.

Private testimony that was taken after market creation and made public by the date specified above will qualify for the purposes of this market.

A qualifying acknowledgment must be explicit and unambiguous. Statements that are clearly sarcastic, made in jest, or immediately clarified as not being genuine will not qualify.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Jensen Huang, NVIDIA, or their official or legal representatives; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

markets.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $160 in November?
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, at any point after market creation and during a Pyth market session of November 2026, any Pyth 1-minute candle for the Active Month of ICE Futures Europe WTI Crude Futures (denoted by Pyth as "CLL") has a final "High" or "Low" price equal to or beyond (above for ↑ High Prices, below for ↓ Low Prices) the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Prices will be used exactly as published by Pyth, without rounding.

Only prices achieved during the Pyth market session on the specified timeframe's business days will be considered. The Pyth market session for a given business day can be seen under "Schedule" in the "Data Coverage" section of the respective CLL price feed on Pyth (See: https://app.pyth.com/explore?search=CLL), and may be modified for holiday or other special hours.

The Active Month is the nearest listed contract, except during that contract's final three trading sessions. At the open of the third-to-last trading session, the next listed contract becomes the Active Month.

Each contract's last trading day will be determined by ICE Futures Europe per the WTI Crude Futures contract specification (generally the 4th US business day prior to the 25th calendar day of the month preceding the contract month, or five US business days prior if the 25th calendar day is not a US business day). The last trading day for each contract is posted at https://www.ice.com/products/213/WTI-Crude-Futures/expiry.

For example, if the last trading session for the nearest listed contract is the session for Monday the 20th, the next listed contract would become the Active Month at the start of the trading session for Thursday the 16th (8:00 PM ET on Wednesday), assuming a standard trading calendar.

If Pyth data is unavailable during the Pyth market session due to a system outage, data failure, or other disruption that prevents verification of the required 1-minute candle data, the official daily high/low price published for the Active Month WTI Crude Oil Futures contract by ICE Futures Europe may be used to determine whether the listed price was reached during the Pyth market session (See: https://www.ice.com/report/10 with "T-West Texas Intermediate Light Sweet Crude Future" selected). The scheduled close of the Pyth market session does not constitute a system outage, data failure, or other disruption, and the ICE Futures Europe daily high/low will not be used to account for prices after this close.

In the event of a contract specification change, feed change, or similar structural modification affecting the underlying market during the listed time frame, this market will resolve based on adjusted prices as displayed on Pyth.

If the Active Month contract does not trade at all during the listed time frame, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market is Pyth — specifically, the ICE Futures Europe WTI Crude Futures Active Month "High" and "Low" prices available at https://app.pyth.com/explore?search=CLL, with the chart settings configured for 1-minute candles. Historical 1-minute candles may be accessed by appending a Unix timestamp (seconds) to the Pyth chart URL using the "t=" parameter.

rows.title: H100 average rental price in March 2027?
rows.original: H100 average rental price in March 2027?

markets.question: Will the average Ornn H100 rental price in March 2027 be above $4.00?
markets.label: Above $4.00
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the average Ornn H100 index value in March 2027 is above the specified price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The average Ornn H100 index value in March 2027 is the arithmetic mean of the finalized daily settled values of the Ornn OCPI-H100 index dated within March 2027, as published by Ornn, rounded to the nearest cent. A daily settled value is considered finalized once the following day's settled value is published. Revisions made after a value has been finalized will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market is Ornn (data.ornn.com), specifically the Ornn Compute Price Index for the H100 (OCPI-H100), currently displayed at https://data.ornn.com/markets/h100-sxm.

In the case that the Resolution Source publishes data, sufficient to settle a Market, that is clearly erroneous and the result of technical or operational error, or of unauthorized interference with the Resolution Source or its data, the Market may remain open for a period of up to seven (7) calendar days (ET) from the time of the expected original release, in anticipation of a correction by the Resolution Source. If the Resolution Source publishes a corrected value within that period, that value will be eligible for resolution.

If any value for March 2027 is not finalized by 11:59 PM ET on the 7th calendar day after March 2027 ends, this market will resolve using the finalized values available at that time.

rows.original: Fed Decision in January?

markets.question: Will the Fed decrease interest rates by 50+ bps after the January 2027 meeting?
markets.label: 降息50基点及以上
markets.rules:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's January 2027 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for January 26-27, 2027 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their January meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

rows.title: Anthropic announces bankruptcy by...?
rows.original: Anthropic announces bankruptcy by...?

markets.question: Will Anthropic announce bankruptcy by December 31, 2027?
markets.label: December 31, 2027
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Anthropic announces that it will file for bankruptcy or has filed for bankruptcy of any variety by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. An announcement will suffice for a "Yes" resolution, regardless of if or when the actual filing occurs. The announcement must be made through any of their official or verified channels, as a recorded or written statement by their CEO, legal representation, or other individual or team which officially represents Anthropic. A definitive consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

"Anthropic" refers to Anthropic, PBC, the parent company of the Anthropic group, or any other entity that is controlled by, or is under common control with, Anthropic, PBC and that holds, directly or indirectly, all or substantially all of Anthropic's business and assets at the time of the filing or announcement. Unless named above, foreign entities, financing entities, special purpose vehicles, and entities used to separate specific legal liabilities will not qualify, even if they meet that test.

A filing for bankruptcy means a petition by an entity this market refers to (each, a "covered entity") under Chapter 7 or Chapter 11 of the United States Bankruptcy Code, or a bankruptcy case for a covered entity filed in a court outside the United States under that country's bankruptcy or insolvency law, including a court-appointed administration. A petition filed against a covered entity by its creditors will qualify only if the court enters an order for relief on that petition by the listed date.

An announcement must state that a covered entity has decided to file for bankruptcy, or has filed for bankruptcy. Statements that the company is considering, exploring, or open to bankruptcy, or that bankruptcy is one of several options, will not qualify.

A definitive consensus of credible reporting may be used to confirm that a qualifying announcement or filing occurred. Reports citing unnamed sources that a covered entity plans or is preparing to file will not qualify on their own.

Once a qualifying filing or announcement occurs, this market will resolve to "Yes" even if the petition is later withdrawn, dismissed, or converted, or the company later reverses its decision.

The following will not qualify on their own: a missed payment or other default on debt; a breach of a loan covenant; foreclosure or other enforcement action by creditors; a credit rating downgrade; a debt exchange or other restructuring agreed outside of court; the appointment of a receiver; and an assignment for the benefit of creditors.

If a covered entity stops existing because of a merger or similar transaction, it will no longer be a covered entity. If, after the merger, no covered entity remains, this market will resolve to "No". If the transaction only changes a covered entity's name, state of incorporation, or legal form, or places a new holding company over the same business, the resulting entity will be treated as that covered entity.

A filing occurs at the time recorded by the court. An announcement occurs at the time it is first published by a covered entity or its representative.

rows.title: Largest IPO by market cap in 2026?
rows.original: Largest IPO by market cap in 2026?

markets.question: Will SpaceX have the highest IPO Market Cap 2026?
markets.label: SpaceX
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to the company that achieves the highest market capitalization in U.S. dollars based on the official closing price on its first trading day in 2026.

This market will resolve to a company that completes an Initial Public Offering (IPO) between January 1 and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

Market capitalization is defined as the total number of outstanding shares multiplied by the closing share price on the first trading day.

If two or more companies have exactly equal highest closing market capitalizations, this market will resolve to the company whose listed name comes first alphabetically.

Resolution will be based on the primary exchange’s official listing page. In the event that the relevant figure is not displayed, another reliable source will be used.

In case the respective company's primary exchange’s official listing page does not report in U.S. dollars, it will be converted to U.S. dollars using the U.S. Federal Reserve Board’s H.10 foreign exchange reference rate for the relevant currency pair on the company’s first trading day (https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/h10/). If no such rate is available for the relevant trading day, the most recent previously published rate will be used. If the relevant currency is not listed, another credible exchange rate source will be used.

A listed company may resolve to "No" as soon as it becomes unable to complete an IPO, including due to acquisition, merger, or absorption by an entity that is already publicly traded.

In the event of an interruption in the course of the normal trading session on the respective companies’ first day of trading (e.g., a circuit breaker or half-day), the market will resolve according to the official closing price of the abbreviated session. If no such official closing price is published, the market will resolve according to the next trading day on which an official closing price is published, treating that as the first day of trading for purposes of this market.

rows.title: What will Gold (GC) hit__ by end of December?
rows.original: What will Gold (GC) hit__ by end of December?

markets.question: Will Gold (GC) dip to (LOW) $3,500 by end of December?
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, on any trading day, the official CME settlement price for the Active Month (front month) of Gold (GC) futures is equal to or below the listed price between market creation and the final trading day of December 2026. Otherwise, the market will resolve to "No". Price action before this market’s creation will not be considered.

For CME Gold (GC) futures contracts, the Active Month is the nearest of CME's designated delivery-cycle months (February, April, June, August, October, December) that is not the spot month. The Active Month changes automatically on the contract's First Position Date, at which point the next eligible contract month becomes the Active Month.

Only the Active Month's official settlement price published by CME Group will be considered. Intraday trades, highs, lows, bids, offers, midpoint values, or indicative prices do not count.

Note that the settlement price may differ from the last traded price. CME's methodology to determine the settlement price can vary by commodity and contract.

Only days on which CME publishes an official settlement price for the Active Month will be included. Days without settlement prices (weekends, holidays, or market closures) are ignored.

This market will resolve based on the settlement price as it appears on the CME settlement page at the time it is first published for that trading day, regardless of any later corrections or updates.

The resolution source for this market is the CME Group website — specifically, the daily "Settlement" price for the Active Month of Gold (GC) futures.  If the official settlement price for any relevant trading day has not been published on the CME Group website within 72 hours of the final trading day (ET) of the specified period, the market will resolve based on the settlement prices published through all CME channels up to that point.

rows.title: H200 average rental price in December 2026?
rows.original: H200 average rental price in December 2026?

markets.question: Will the average Ornn H200 rental price in December 2026 be above $8.00?
markets.label: Above $8.00
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the average Ornn H200 index value in December 2026 is above the specified price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The average Ornn H200 index value in December 2026 is the arithmetic mean of the finalized daily settled values of the Ornn OCPI-H200 index dated within December 2026, as published by Ornn, rounded to the nearest cent. A daily settled value is considered finalized once the following day's settled value is published. Revisions made after a value has been finalized will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market is Ornn (data.ornn.com), specifically the Ornn Compute Price Index for the H200 (OCPI-H200), currently displayed at https://data.ornn.com/markets/h200.

In the case that the Resolution Source publishes data, sufficient to settle a Market, that is clearly erroneous and the result of technical or operational error, or of unauthorized interference with the Resolution Source or its data, the Market may remain open for a period of up to seven (7) calendar days (ET) from the time of the expected original release, in anticipation of a correction by the Resolution Source. If the Resolution Source publishes a corrected value within that period, that value will be eligible for resolution.

If any value for December 2026 is not finalized by 11:59 PM ET on the 7th calendar day after December 2026 ends, this market will resolve using the finalized values available at that time.

If Ornn discontinues the OCPI-H200 index, the page becomes unavailable, or Ornn materially changes the index methodology or unit of measure, and as a result no finalized OCPI-H200 values dated within December 2026 are available by 11:59 PM ET on January 7, 2027, another credible source of H200 rental price data will be considered. If no such source is available, this market will resolve 50-50.

rows.title: OpenAI IPO Closing Market Cap
rows.original: OpenAI IPO Closing Market Cap

markets.question: Will OpenAI’s market cap be less than $500B at market close on IPO day by December 31, 2027?
markets.label: <500B
markets.rules:
This market will resolve based on OpenAI's market capitalization at the closing price on its first day of trading.

If no IPO occurs by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "No IPO by December 31, 2027".

Market capitalization expresses the monetary value of a company’s outstanding shares, stated in its pricing currency. It is calculated as the number of shares outstanding multiplied by the closing share price on the first trading day.

If the relevant value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

Resolution will be based on the primary exchange’s official listing page. In the event that the relevant figure is not displayed, another reliable source will be used.

In the event of an interruption in the course of the normal trading session on OpenAI’s first day of trading (e.g., a circuit breaker or half-day), the market will resolve according to the official closing price of the abbreviated session. If no such official closing price is published, the market will resolve according to the next trading day on which an official closing price is published, treating that as the first day of trading for purposes of this market.

markets.rules:

The company trades under the ticker listed in the market title as of the creation of this market.

If the specified metric is reported as a range rather than a specific number, the midpoint of the range will be used for resolution of this market.

The resolution source for this market is Anthropic's official company earnings materials, including press releases, investor presentations, and regulatory filings.

rows.title: H100 average rental price in February 2027?
rows.original: H100 average rental price in February 2027?

markets.question: Will the average Ornn H100 rental price in February 2027 be above $3.80?
markets.label: Above $3.80
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the average Ornn H100 index value in February 2027 is above the specified price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The average Ornn H100 index value in February 2027 is the arithmetic mean of the finalized daily settled values of the Ornn OCPI-H100 index dated within February 2027, as published by Ornn, rounded to the nearest cent. A daily settled value is considered finalized once the following day's settled value is published. Revisions made after a value has been finalized will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market is Ornn (data.ornn.com), specifically the Ornn Compute Price Index for the H100 (OCPI-H100), currently displayed at https://data.ornn.com/markets/h100-sxm.

In the case that the Resolution Source publishes data, sufficient to settle a Market, that is clearly erroneous and the result of technical or operational error, or of unauthorized interference with the Resolution Source or its data, the Market may remain open for a period of up to seven (7) calendar days (ET) from the time of the expected original release, in anticipation of a correction by the Resolution Source. If the Resolution Source publishes a corrected value within that period, that value will be eligible for resolution.

If any value for February 2027 is not finalized by 11:59 PM ET on the 7th calendar day after February 2027 ends, this market will resolve using the finalized values available at that time.

If Ornn discontinues the OCPI-H100 index, the page becomes unavailable, or Ornn materially changes the index methodology or unit of measure, and as a result no finalized OCPI-H100 values dated within February 2027 are available by 11:59 PM ET on March 7, 2027, another credible source of H100 rental price data will be considered. If no such source is available, this market will resolve 50-50.

rows.title: AI bubble burst by...?
rows.original: AI bubble burst by...?

markets.question: AI bubble burst in 2026?
markets.label: December 31, 2026
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the AI industry experiences an industry downturn by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For the purposes of this market, the AI industry will be considered to have experienced an industry downturn once at least three of the following events have occurred within 90 days of this market's specified timeframe:
- NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) closing stock price is down 50% from its all-time high.
- iShares PHLX Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) closing stock price is down 40% from its all-time high.
- OpenAI, Inc. or Anthropic PBC declares bankruptcy.
- OpenAI, Inc. is acquired.
- H100 rental price falls to $1.00 or lower for five consecutive days, as shown on the SiliconData Silicon Index at:
https://www.silicondata.com/products/silicon-index.
- Major AI Hardware Supplier Collapse: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (TSM), ASML Holding N.V. (ASML), Broadcom Inc. (AVGO), Arista Networks, Inc. (ANET), or Super Micro Computer, Inc. (SMCI), closing stock price is down 50% from its all-time high.

This market may resolve immediately once three conditions have been met within 90 days of the specified timeframe.

This market will not resolve to "Yes" until three conditions have been met, regardless of reporting of an industry downturn or similar claims.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the respective companies and listing exchanges; however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

rows.title: How many Jensen Huang affairs will be reported by December 31?
rows.original: How many Jensen Huang affairs will be reported by December 31?

markets.question: Will 3 Jensen Huang affairs be reported by December 31?
markets.rules:
On November 8, 2026, Jensen Huang acknowledged in a message to NVIDIA employees that he had been unfaithful to his wife; news reports have identified the woman involved as Alice Huang. On November 11, 2026, The New York Times reported that Huang had also had an affair with Kimberly Powell, NVIDIA’s vice president of healthcare; Huang, Powell and NVIDIA have not confirmed that report. On November 12, 2026, Reuters reported that Huang had an intimate relationship with a second NVIDIA employee, whom it did not name.

This market will resolve according to the number of people with whom Jensen Huang has been reported to have had an affair as of December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. The count starts at three (Alice Huang, Kimberly Powell and the NVIDIA employee reported by Reuters) and increases by one for each additional person who is the subject of a qualifying report published by a qualifying outlet between market creation and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

An affair refers to a romantic or sexual relationship outside Jensen Huang’s marriage. The affair itself may have taken place at any time during his marriage; only the timing of the report matters.

The qualifying outlets are The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, Financial Times, Reuters, the Associated Press, CNN, Bloomberg, ABC News, CBS News, NBC News and Fox News. Only news articles published on an outlet’s own platform qualify; editorials, opinion pieces, columns, broadcast or video segments, podcasts, social media posts and sponsored content will not qualify.

A report will qualify if it meets any of the following:
1. presents the affair as fact;
2. reports the affair based on the outlet’s own sourcing, such as people familiar with the matter, documents or recordings (as in The New York Times’ November 11, 2026 report on Kimberly Powell);
3. reports an alleged affair between Jensen Huang and a specific person other than Alice Huang, Kimberly Powell, the employee reported by Reuters or anyone else already counted, regardless of whether the outlet presents the allegation as credible; or
4. reports that Jensen Huang, directly or through his official or legal representatives, has acknowledged such an affair.

Reports under 1 or 2 qualify whether or not the person involved is named, provided they clearly distinguish that person from Alice Huang, Kimberly Powell, the unnamed NVIDIA employee reported by Reuters and anyone else already counted. A report does so if it, or other reporting from a qualifying outlet, makes clear that the person is not someone already counted (e.g., by describing them as a third NVIDIA employee with whom Huang had a relationship, or as someone who has never worked at NVIDIA). A report confirming that Huang had affairs with at least a stated number of people will set the count to that number if it is higher than the count otherwise established.

If it is unclear whether a person in a report is someone already counted, that person will be treated as already counted, and this market will resolve to the lower number.

The following will not add to the count:
(i) reports that name or otherwise identify the NVIDIA employee reported by Reuters or anyone else already counted;
(ii) reports about any person, named or unnamed, that do not make clear, on their own or together with other reporting from a qualifying outlet, that the person is not someone already counted;
(iii) general references to Huang’s infidelity (e.g., “Huang has been unfaithful for a while”); and
(iv) allegations about an unnamed person that the outlet only relays from others, such as social media posts or other outlets’ reporting.

A report under 4 qualifies only if it reports an acknowledgment, including one in private testimony that has been made public, that names a person who is distinguished from those already counted as described above, or makes clear that Huang was unfaithful with more people than the count otherwise established (for example, by acknowledging affairs with four or more people). Reports of acknowledgments that are not explicit and unambiguous, or that are clearly sarcastic, made in jest or immediately clarified as not being genuine, will not qualify.

Alice Huang, Kimberly Powell and the NVIDIA employee reported by Reuters count toward the total even though they were reported before market creation. Any additional person counts only if a qualifying report about them is first published between market creation and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Reports that only reference or link to articles published before market creation will not qualify unless they themselves meet the requirements above, and an article first published before market creation will qualify only if a later update first makes it meet those requirements, in which case the time of the update governs.

The resolution source for this market will be reporting from the qualifying outlets; for acknowledgments, official information from Jensen Huang or his official or legal representatives may also be used.

rows.title: NVIDIA VP Kimberly Powell announced resignation or removal by...?
rows.original: NVIDIA VP Kimberly Powell announced resignation or removal by...?

markets.question: Kimberly Powell announced resignation or removal by November 30, 2026?
markets.label: November 30, 2026
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Kimberly Powell’s departure through resignation or removal as Vice President of Healthcare at NVIDIA is officially announced by November 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

The departure will be considered to be announced when Kimberly Powell, NVIDIA, or their authorized representatives publicly and definitively announce that Powell has resigned or been removed, or will resign or be removed, as Vice President of Healthcare at NVIDIA. Such an announcement will qualify regardless of when the specified person formally leaves the position; resignation includes retiring or stepping down from the position, including to take another role at NVIDIA, and removal includes dismissal or termination by NVIDIA. A change in the title of the position, including a promotion, will not be considered a departure if Powell continues to lead NVIDIA’s healthcare business.

Only announcements which are framed as announcing a departure through resignation or removal intended to be effective within 18 months of the date of the announcement will qualify (e.g., neither “I will leave office in 2 years,” nor “I will not be in office forever,” would qualify).

Announcements of temporary leaves of absence, dated suspensions, indefinite suspensions, administrative leaves, or other temporary changes to the specified person’s duties in the specified position do not qualify.

The following do not qualify as public and definitive announcements: statements that the specified person is considering or open to departing; conditional statements that the specified person will depart only if certain conditions are met; the announcement of an offer of resignation that requires acceptance and remains pending or has been refused; media reports that the specified person plans to depart; statements made in sarcasm or jest; and statements by persons other than the specified person, the relevant authority governing the specified position, or their respective authorized representatives.

If the specified person holds the specified position on a predefined term with a scheduled end date, only announcements that they will depart the position prior to the scheduled end of their term qualify.

If the specified person formally ceases to hold the specified position before the end of their scheduled term through such a departure without a qualifying announcement, the market will resolve to “Yes” if a qualifying resignation or removal occurs by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. If the specified person ceases to hold the specified position by any other means, this market will resolve to “No”.

The primary resolution sources for this market will be official information from Kimberly Powell and NVIDIA; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

rows.title: Will Anthropic’s valuation hit __ by December 31?
rows.original: Will Anthropic’s valuation hit __ by December 31?

markets.question: Will Anthropic's valuation hit (HIGH) $3.0T by December 31?
markets.label: ↑$3.0T
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Anthropic's private market valuation, as measured by the NPM Price reported by Nasdaq Private Market, LLC (NPM) for any date between market creation and December 31, 2026, is equal to or beyond (equal to or above for ↑ HIGH valuations, equal to or below for ↓ LOW valuations) the listed amount. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

NPM Prices are published for trading days only and are updated once daily at 1:00 PM ET on the following calendar day.

If NPM has not published relevant data for all business dates in the specified period by 1:00 PM ET on January 1, 2027, this market may remain open until 11:59 PM ET on January 4, 2027. If no further data is released by that time, the market will resolve according to the data available.

If NPM ceases publishing relevant data prior to the end of the specified period, this market will resolve based on the NPM data published for the period prior to the cessation of coverage, as well as any applicable public market capitalization data following an IPO or direct listing.

If the company completes an IPO or direct listing before the end of the specified period, this market will consider, in addition to the relevant NPM valuations published between market creation and the IPO or direct listing date, the valuation implied by the official IPO or direct listing price, and the company's public market capitalization between the IPO or direct listing date and the end of the specified period.

Public market capitalization will be determined using the highest/lowest official regular-hours trading price published for the company's primary listed common equity on its primary exchange for any trading day during the specified period, multiplied by the company's total outstanding common shares at the relevant time.

If the listed company merges with or acquires another entity and remains the parent company, no change to resolution methodology applies.

If the listed company is acquired, merges into another entity and is no longer the surviving parent company, or otherwise ceases to exist as an independent entity prior to the end of the period, only NPM valuations and applicable public market capitalizations achieved prior to completion of the transaction will be considered for resolution. No transaction, acquisition, or merger consideration will be considered for resolution.

The resolution source for this market is NPM data published here: (https://fe.secondmarket.com/companies/company-3e197763-4ff8-4d8c-bd1f-cc2792937757/data). The resolution source for any period following an IPO, direct listing, or relevant corporate action, will be official exchange trading data and publicly reported share counts.

Revisions to previously published NPM data made after their initial release will not be considered, unless made to correct clearly erroneous data.

markets.question: Will Thinking Machines Lab be acquired before 2028?
markets.label: Thinking Machines Lab
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, between market creation and December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the listed company and/or an acquiring entity officially announce that they have entered into a definitive agreement for that entity to acquire the listed company. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No". 

The announcement must be made by the listed company, the acquiring entity, or both, for example through a press release, regulatory filing, or official company statement. Media reports of talks, negotiations, offers, bids, term sheets, letters of intent, or any other non-binding or unconfirmed arrangement will not qualify. 

A definitive agreement for an acquiring entity to obtain a majority of the listed company's equity or voting control, or to purchase substantially all of its assets, will qualify. 

A group of buyers counts as one acquiring entity only if they are officially announced as jointly acquiring the listed company. Equity sold to multiple investors in a financing round will not qualify, even if those investors together hold a majority. 

A merger will qualify if, under its announced terms, the listed company's existing shareholders will own less than half of the combined company. 

Minority investments, strategic partnerships, licensing agreements, internal reorganizations, and the hiring of the listed company's founders or employees will not alone qualify, whether or not the listed company continues to operate afterward. A license to the listed company's technology or intellectual property, however broad, exclusive, or perpetual, does not count as a purchase of its assets. 

An officially announced definitive agreement will qualify for a "Yes" resolution regardless of whether the acquisition is ultimately completed.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the listed company and/or the acquiring entity.

markets.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by November 30?
markets.label: Yes（是）
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and November 30, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. markets.question: Will Crude Oil reach a new all-time high by December 31?
markets.label: December 31
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, on any trading day after market creation, the official daily high price published by the CME Group for the Active Month (front month) of CME Crude Oil (CL) futures is greater than $147.27 by the final trading day on or before the specified date. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For CME Crude Oil (CL) futures contracts, the active month is the nearest of the contract months listed. The active month becomes a non-active month effective two business days prior to the spot month expiration. For example, if the spot month expires on a Friday the next listed contract will be considered the Active Month on the Wednesday prior to the spot month expiration.

This market will resolve as soon as a high price greater than the listed value is published, or once finalized data for the final trading day of the specified time period is published and a high price greater than $147.27 has not been achieved.

The resolution source for this market is the CME Group website (https://www.cmegroup.com/markets/energy/crude-oil/light-sweet-crude.quotes.html) — specifically, the daily "High" prices for the Active Month of Crude Oil (CL) futures. If finalized data for the final trading day of the specified time period has not been published on the CME Group website within 14 calendar days (ET) of the end of that period, this market will resolve based on the data published through all CME Group channels up to that point.

markets.question: Will the average Ornn B300 rental price in September 2027 be above $18.00?
markets.label: Above $18.00
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the average Ornn B300 index value in September 2027 is above the specified price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The average Ornn B300 index value in September 2027 is the arithmetic mean of the finalized daily settled values of the Ornn OCPI-B300 index dated within September 2027, as published by Ornn, rounded to the nearest cent. A daily settled value is considered finalized once the following day's settled value is published. Revisions made after a value has been finalized will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market is Ornn (data.ornn.com), specifically the Ornn Compute Price Index for the B300 (OCPI-B300), currently displayed at https://data.ornn.com/markets/b300.

In the case that the Resolution Source publishes data, sufficient to settle a Market, that is clearly erroneous and the result of technical or operational error, or of unauthorized interference with the Resolution Source or its data, the Market may remain open for a period of up to seven (7) calendar days (ET) from the time of the expected original release, in anticipation of a correction by the Resolution Source. If the Resolution Source publishes a corrected value within that period, that value will be eligible for resolution.

If any value for September 2027 is not finalized by 11:59 PM ET on the 7th calendar day after September 2027 ends, this market will resolve using the finalized values available at that time.

If Ornn discontinues the OCPI-B300 index, the page becomes unavailable, or Ornn materially changes the index methodology or unit of measure, and as a result no finalized OCPI-B300 values dated within September 2027 are available by 11:59 PM ET on October 7, 2027, another credible source of B300 rental price data will be considered. rows.title: Jensen Huang resigned or removed & Nvidia above $4T end of 2026?
rows.original: Jensen Huang resigned or removed & Nvidia above $4T end of 2026?

markets.question: Will Jensen Huang's resignation or removal be announced and Nvidia's market cap be above $4T at the end of 2026?
markets.label: Resigned/removed; Over $4T
markets.rules:
This market will resolve according to the combined outcome of (1) whether Jensen Huang’s departure through resignation or removal as CEO of NVIDIA is officially announced by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET and (2) whether Nvidia's public market capitalization at the close of regular trading on the final trading day of 2026 is above $4 trillion.

Options beginning "Resigned/removed" require Jensen Huang’s departure through resignation or removal as CEO of NVIDIA to be officially announced by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Options beginning "Not resigned/removed" require no such announcement by that time. Each option then names the result of the second component ("Over $4T" or "Under $4T"), as defined below. The option matching both results will resolve to "Yes", and all other options will resolve to "No".

Jensen Huang resignation or removal: The departure will be considered to be announced when Jensen Huang, NVIDIA, or their authorized representatives publicly and definitively announce that Huang has resigned or been removed, or will resign or be removed, as CEO of NVIDIA. Such an announcement will qualify regardless of when the specified person formally leaves the position; resignation includes retiring or stepping down as CEO, including to take another role at NVIDIA, and removal includes dismissal or termination by NVIDIA’s Board of Directors.

Only announcements which are framed as announcing a departure through resignation or removal intended to be effective within 18 months of the date of the announcement will qualify (e.g., neither “I will leave office in 2 years,” nor “I will not be in office forever,” would qualify).

Announcements of temporary leaves of absence, dated suspensions, indefinite suspensions, administrative leaves, or other temporary changes to the specified person’s duties in the specified position do not qualify.

The following do not qualify as public and definitive announcements: statements that the specified person is considering or open to departing; conditional statements that the specified person will depart only if certain conditions are met; the announcement of an offer of resignation that requires acceptance and remains pending or has been refused; media reports that the specified person plans to depart; statements made in sarcasm or jest; and statements by persons other than the specified person, the relevant authority governing the specified position, or their respective authorized representatives.

If the specified person holds the specified position on a predefined term with a scheduled end date, only announcements that they will depart the position prior to the scheduled end of their term qualify.

If the specified person formally ceases to hold the specified position before the end of their scheduled term through such a departure without a qualifying announcement, this component will be "Resigned/removed" if a qualifying resignation or removal occurs by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. If the specified person ceases to hold the specified position by any other means, this component will be "Not resigned/removed".

The primary resolution sources for this component will be official information from Jensen Huang and NVIDIA; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

Nvidia market cap: This component is "Over $4T" if Nvidia's public market capitalization at the close of regular trading on the final trading day of 2026 is $4 trillion or greater. Otherwise, it is "Under $4T".

Public market capitalization will be determined through appropriate calculation using the final official regular-hours closing prices published for the company's listed equities on its primary exchange for the last trading day of 2026, multiplied by the company's total number of shares outstanding at the relevant time. If necessary, to accurately capture the company’s total market capitalization, rather than a stock-class-specific market capitalization, the calculation will include all outstanding share classes and apply any stated conversion ratios to the publicly traded class. Where no conversion right exists, such shares will be counted at their stated outstanding amount without discount, unless official filings explicitly specify differently. The number of outstanding shares will be determined from official company filings or disclosures (e.g., SEC filings).

If the listed company merges with or acquires another entity and remains the parent company, no change to resolution methodology applies.

If the listed company is acquired, merges into another entity and is no longer the surviving parent company, or otherwise ceases to exist as an independent entity prior to the end of the period, the public market capitalizations achieved prior to completion of the transaction will be considered for resolution. No transaction, acquisition, or merger consideration will be considered for resolution.

The resolution source for this component is official exchange trading data and publicly reported share counts.

rows.title: Canadian unwrought aluminum duty rate on December 31, 2027?
rows.original: Canadian unwrought aluminum duty rate on December 31, 2027?

markets.question: Will the US Section 232 tariff rate on Canadian primary aluminum be 0% on December 31, 2027?
markets.rules:
This market will resolve according to the Section 232 duty rate applicable to Canadian unwrought aluminum as of 12:01 AM ET on December 31, 2027.

“Canadian unwrought aluminum” refers to unwrought aluminum not alloyed (HTSUS subheading 7601.10), that is a product of Canada and for which Canada is both the country of smelt and the country of most recent cast.

Only the rate applicable generally to Canadian unwrought aluminum will be considered. Company-specific or project-specific reduced rates, product exclusions, and special rates for US-origin metal will not be considered. Ordinary customs duties, Section 338 duties, antidumping and countervailing duties, and any other tariff will not be considered. If a tariff-rate quota applies, the in-quota rate will be used, whether or not the quota has been filled at the measurement time. If different general rates apply to different goods within subheading 7601.10, the lowest of those rates will be used.

Only the rate legally in effect at the measurement time counts. A change that has been announced or signed but is not in effect as of 12:01 AM ET on December 31, 2027 will not be considered. A change which goes into effect at that time will qualify. A change signed after the measurement time will not be considered, even if it is made retroactive to a date on or before December 31, 2027.

If Section 232 aluminum duties do not apply to Canadian unwrought aluminum at the measurement time for any reason, including an exemption, a termination, a suspension, or a court order that is in effect and has not been stayed, the market will resolve to “0%“.

If the Section 232 duty rate applicable to Canadian unwrought aluminum in effect as of 12:01 AM ET on December 31, 2027 is not expressed solely as an ad valorem percentage, including where it is a specific duty or a combination of a percentage and a specific duty, this market will resolve to “Other.”

The primary resolution sources will be presidential proclamations and executive orders published on whitehouse.gov and in the Federal Register, Federal Register notices issued under them, and HTSUS Chapter 99 as published by the US International Trade Commission. If these sources conflict, the most recent legally effective proclamation, executive order, or Federal Register notice will govern, followed by the HTSUS, and then the US Customs and Border Protection CSMS guidance.

rows.title: Another NVIDIA board member announced resignation or removal by...?
rows.original: Another NVIDIA board member announced resignation or removal by...?

markets.question: Another NVIDIA board member announced resignation or removal by November 30, 2026?
markets.label: November 30, 2026
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if the departure of any member of NVIDIA’s Board of Directors, other than Jensen Huang, through resignation or removal from the Board of Directors is officially announced between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For the purposes of this market, the specified person refers to any individual, other than Jensen Huang, who is a member of NVIDIA’s Board of Directors at any time between market creation and the specified date, including directors appointed after market creation. Announcements made before this market’s creation, including the announcement of Jensen Huang’s resignation from the Board of Directors, will not qualify.

The departure will be considered to be announced when the specified person, NVIDIA, or their authorized representatives publicly and definitively announce that the specified person has resigned or been removed, or will resign or be removed, as a member of NVIDIA’s Board of Directors. Such an announcement will qualify regardless of when the specified person formally leaves the position; resignation includes retiring or stepping down from the Board of Directors, and removal includes removal by NVIDIA’s stockholders. Departures from executive roles at NVIDIA (e.g., CEO) will not qualify if the specified person remains a member of the Board of Directors.

Only announcements which are framed as announcing a departure through resignation or removal intended to be effective within 18 months of the date of the announcement will qualify (e.g., neither “I will leave office in 2 years,” nor “I will not be in office forever,” would qualify).

Announcements of temporary leaves of absence, dated suspensions, indefinite suspensions, administrative leaves, or other temporary changes to the specified person’s duties in the specified position do not qualify.

The following do not qualify as public and definitive announcements: statements that the specified person is considering or open to departing; conditional statements that the specified person will depart only if certain conditions are met; the announcement of an offer of resignation that requires acceptance and remains pending or has been refused; media reports that the specified person plans to depart; statements made in sarcasm or jest; and statements by persons other than the specified person, the relevant authority governing the specified position, or their respective authorized representatives.

If the specified person holds the specified position on a predefined term with a scheduled end date, only announcements that they will depart the position prior to the scheduled end of their term qualify.

If the specified person formally ceases to hold the specified position before the end of their scheduled term through such a departure without a qualifying announcement, the market will resolve to “Yes” if a qualifying resignation or removal occurs by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. If the specified person ceases to hold the specified position by any other means, this will not count toward the resolution of this market.

The primary resolution sources for this market will be official information from NVIDIA and its Board of Directors; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

markets.question: Will Gold (XAUUSD) hit (HIGH) $4,600 in November?
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, at any point after market creation and during a trading session of November 2026, any 1-minute candle for Gold (XAUUSD) has a final "High" or "Low" price equal to or beyond (above for ↑ High Prices, below for ↓ Low Prices) the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Only prices achieved during an applicable trading session of the specified timeframe's business days will be considered. The trading session for a given business day typically begins at 6:00 PM ET on the prior calendar date. Under the standard schedule, trading is open from 6:00:00 PM ET Sunday through 5:00:00 PM ET Friday, with a daily break from 5:00:00 PM ET to 6:00:00 PM ET, except where modified by holiday or special-session hours.

Prices will be used exactly as published by Pyth, without rounding.

If Gold (XAUUSD) does not trade at all during the listed time frame, this market will resolve to "No".

In the event of a contract specification change, feed change, or similar structural modification affecting the market during the listed time frame, this market will resolve based on adjusted prices as displayed on Pyth.

The resolution source for this market is Pyth — specifically, the Gold (XAUUSD) "High" and "Low" prices available at https://pythdata.app/explore/Metal.XAU%2FUSD, with the chart settings configured for 1-minute candles.

Historical 1-minute candles may be accessed by appending a Unix timestamp (seconds) to the Pyth chart URL using the "t=" parameter.

If the relevant Pyth data is unavailable due to a system outage, data failure, or other technical disruption that prevents verification of the required 1-minute candle data, the official daily high/low price published for the relevant CME COMEX futures contract for the underlying metal—COMEX Gold Futures (GC)—may be used to determine whether the listed price was reached during the applicable trading session.

rows.title: GPU compute futures trading in the US by...?
rows.original: GPU compute futures trading in the US by...?

markets.question: Will a GPU compute futures contract trade on a US exchange by December 31, 2026?
markets.label: December 31, 2026
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a GPU compute futures contract is traded on a federally regulated US exchange by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A GPU compute futures contract means a futures contract listed on a designated contract market registered with the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission that settles based on a price or price index for graphics processing unit (GPU) compute, such as a GPU rental price per GPU-hour. Options on futures, perpetual futures, event contracts, binary contracts, and futures based on company share prices, electricity, or data center capacity do not qualify.

A GPU compute futures contract is traded once at least one trade in the contract has been executed competitively on the exchange's centralized market on its live production venue. Block trades, exchange-for-related-position transactions, and other privately negotiated trades executed away from the centralized market do not qualify. Announcements, regulatory filings, regulatory approvals, listings with no executed trade, scheduled future launch dates, and test or simulation environments do not qualify.

If a qualifying trade occurs by the deadline, this market will resolve to "Yes" even if the contract is later suspended or delisted.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the listing exchange; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

rows.title: Brazil Annual Inflation 2026
rows.original: Brazil Annual Inflation 2026

markets.question: Will Brazil’s Annual Inflation in 2026 be less than 3.00%?
markets.rules:
This is a market about the variation of consumer prices in Brazil over the 12-month period ending December 2026, as reported by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE).

This market will resolve according to the percentage change in the Extended National Consumer Price Index (IPCA) during the 12-month period ending December 2026 according to the monthly IBGE report.

The resolution source for this market will be the IBGE Extended National Consumer Price Index monthly report released for December 2026, currently scheduled to be released on January 12, 2027. Resolution of this market will take place upon release of the aforementioned data. If no data for the specified month is released by the date the next month's data is scheduled to be released, this market will resolve based on data from the last available month.

You can find the relevant figure by locating the report for December 2026 on the Press Releases page (https://agenciadenoticias.ibge.gov.br/en/agencia-press-room.html), locating the Period-Rate table and finding the IPCA growth rate figure in the column labeled "Rate" and the Row labeled “Cumulative in the year / 12 Months”. Changes in the IBGE’s reporting format will not disqualify a published relevant figure from counting.

Note: the resolution source for this market will be the official monthly IBGE IPCA news release which reports inflation during 12-month periods to two decimal points (e.g. 4.26%). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market. For the full release schedule, see: https://www.ibge.gov.br/en/calendar.html

rows.title: Fed decisions (Sep–Dec)
rows.original: Fed decisions (Sep–Dec)

markets.question: Will the Fed Hike–Pause–Hike in the next three decisions (Sep–Oct–Dec)?
markets.label: Hike–Pause–Hike
markets.rules:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds rate. The decisions on the target federal funds rate are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve according to the decisions made by the next three Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings: September 15-16; October 27-28; and December 8-9.

A qualifying cut occurs when the new upper bound of the target federal funds rate is lower compared to the level it was prior to the respective meeting.

A qualifying hike occurs when the new upper bound of the target federal funds rate is higher compared to the level it was prior to the respective meeting.

A qualifying pause occurs when the new upper bound of the target federal funds rate is equal to the level it was prior to the respective meeting.

If the Fed publishes a different combination than any listed, this market will resolve to "Other". Any rate cut will be encompassed by "Other".

Emergency rate changes outside the regularly scheduled meetings will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meetings:
https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve:
https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm

rows.title: H100 average rental price in September 2027?
rows.original: H100 average rental price in September 2027?

markets.question: Will the average Ornn H100 rental price in September 2027 be above $4.20?
markets.label: Above $4.20
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the average Ornn H100 index value in September 2027 is above the specified price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The average Ornn H100 index value in September 2027 is the arithmetic mean of the finalized daily settled values of the Ornn OCPI-H100 index dated within September 2027, as published by Ornn, rounded to the nearest cent. A daily settled value is considered finalized once the following day's settled value is published. Revisions made after a value has been finalized will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market is Ornn (data.ornn.com), specifically the Ornn Compute Price Index for the H100 (OCPI-H100), currently displayed at https://data.ornn.com/markets/h100-sxm.

In the case that the Resolution Source publishes data, sufficient to settle a Market, that is clearly erroneous and the result of technical or operational error, or of unauthorized interference with the Resolution Source or its data, the Market may remain open for a period of up to seven (7) calendar days (ET) from the time of the expected original release, in anticipation of a correction by the Resolution Source. If the Resolution Source publishes a corrected value within that period, that value will be eligible for resolution.

If any value for September 2027 is not finalized by 11:59 PM ET on the 7th calendar day after September 2027 ends, this market will resolve using the finalized values available at that time.

If Ornn discontinues the OCPI-H100 index, the page becomes unavailable, or Ornn materially changes the index methodology or unit of measure, and as a result no finalized OCPI-H100 values dated within September 2027 are available by 11:59 PM ET on October 7, 2027, another credible source of H100 rental price data will be considered. If no such source is available, this market will resolve 50-50.

rows.title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
rows.original: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?

markets.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
markets.label: Yes（是）
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and December 31, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions to previously published data points after data is published for December 31, 2026, however, will not be considered.

In case of obvious data integrity issues (i.e., erroneous data), the market may remain open until the end of the third calendar day (ET) after the date on which such data is first released to allow for corrections. Data integrity issues refer only to clerical or other similar errors in the underlying data, and do not include cases where IMF Portwatch differs from alternative sources.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF Portwatch, specifically the transit calls data published for the Strait of Hormuz at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/cb5856222a5b4105adc6ee7e880a1730, both in the chart and through downloadable files.

rows.title: Bank of Russia decision in December?
rows.original: Bank of Russia decision in December?

markets.question: Will the Bank of Russia announce a 50+ bps decrease at the December 2026 meeting?
markets.label: 降息50基点及以上
markets.rules:
This market will resolve according to the change in basis points in the key rate resulting from the December 2026 meeting of the Bank of Russia, relative to the level it was prior to this meeting.

The resolution source will be official information from the Bank of Russia, including the statement or release from its December 2026 meeting, scheduled for December 18, 2026, as listed on the official Bank of Russia calendar (https://www.cbr.ru/eng/dkp/cal_mp/#t13). This market may resolve as soon as the statement or release of the Bank of Russia resulting from its December 2026 meeting with relevant data is issued.

If the specified rate is defined by an upper and lower bound, the relevant change will be the change to the upper bound.

If the specified rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded according to the following guidelines. Increases or decreases of less than 25 bps will be rounded to 25 bps (e.g. an increase or decrease of 10 bps would be considered to be an increase or decrease of 25 bps). Increases or decreases of greater than 25 bps will be rounded to the nearest 25 bps and will be rounded away from 0 in cases of equidistance (e.g., an increase or decrease of 37.5 bps would be considered to be an increase or decrease of 50 bps). Displayed options of “Increase” or “Decrease” will include policy rate increases or decreases of any size.

If the specified meeting is postponed to a date and time before the start of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve based on the outcome of that postponed meeting. If the specified meeting is cancelled, or postponed such that no decision is announced by the start of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the “No Change” bracket. Emergency changes to the specified rate not resulting from the specified meeting will not be considered.
